source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "privatization of public space" OR "privatisation of public space" OR "privately owned public space" OR "privately owned public spaces" OR "pseudo-public"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"privatization of public space" OR "privatisation of public space" OR "privately owned public space" OR "privately owned public spaces" OR "pseudo-public",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("privately owned public space" OR "privately owned public spaces" OR "privatisation of public space" OR "privatization of public space" OR "pseudo-public")
